meaning_en: a newspaper
example_en: I read a paper every morning.
examples_extra: He reads a paper every morning with his coffee.
She bought a paper at the station.
note_fa: «a paper = یک روزنامه؛ ولی paper بدون a یعنی «کاغذ».»

meaning_en: Short for advertisement; a public notice.
example_en: Did you see the ad for the concert?
examples_extra: I saw the ad/advert in yesterday's paper.
Write a short ad/advert for your old bike.
note_fa: «هر دو مخفف advertisement؛ advert بیشتر بریتانیایی است.»

meaning_en: A short film or message promoting a product.
example_en: I saw an advert for a new car.
examples_extra: I saw an advert for a new phone on TV.
She answered an advert for a part-time job.
note_fa: شکل کوتاه و غیررسمی advertisement؛ در بریتانیا رایج‌تر است.

meaning_en: short for air conditioning
example_en: It's hot, let's turn on the air con.
examples_extra: The car has air con, so the trip was comfortable.
Turn on the air con; it's too hot in here.
note_fa: شکل کوتاه و غیررسمی air conditioning.

meaning_en: also known as
example_en: John Smith, AKA "The Boss," arrived.
examples_extra: The singer, AKA 'Luna', released a new song.
James Smith, AKA Jim, is my neighbour.
note_fa: مخفف also known as؛ غیررسمی و نوشتاری.

meaning_en: And other similar things.
example_en: We discussed plans, budgets, and so on.
examples_extra: We need pens, paper, envelopes, and so on.
He likes jazz, blues, rock, and so on.

meaning_en: As soon as possible.
example_en: Please send the report ASAP.
examples_extra: Please call me back ASAP; the matter is urgent.
Send the report to the office ASAP today.
note_fa: فقط در متن‌های غیررسمی و پیام کوتاه به کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: A machine where you can get money.
example_en: I need to find an ATM to withdraw cash.
examples_extra: I need to stop at the ATM to get some cash.
The ATM near my house is open all night.

meaning_en: Absent Without Leave; missing from duty.
example_en: The soldier went AWOL from the army.
examples_extra: The young soldier went AWOL during the night.
Two factory workers went AWOL and never returned.
note_fa: مخفف Absent Without Leave؛ بیشتر در زمینهٔ نظامی است.

meaning_en: British Broadcasting Corporation, a UK public broadcaster.
example_en: I watch the news on the BBC.
examples_extra: The BBC broadcasts news programmes in many different languages.
She works as a reporter for the BBC in London.

meaning_en: A bicycle.
example_en: Let's ride our bikes to the park.
examples_extra: I hired a bike for the day and rode to the lake.
She goes to school by bike every day.

meaning_en: A large surface for writing or drawing on.
example_en: The teacher wrote the homework on the board.
examples_extra: The answers to the exercise are on the board.
Please clean the board carefully after the class.

meaning_en: Short for carbohydrates, a type of food.
example_en: Pasta and bread are good sources of carbs.
examples_extra: Rice and bread are the main source of carbs in my diet.
Athletes eat plenty of carbs before a big race.
note_fa: مخفف carbohydrates؛ یکی از درشت‌مغذی‌های رژیم غذایی است.

meaning_en: A matter being investigated by the police or court.
example_en: The police are working on a new case.
examples_extra: The police are investigating a difficult case of theft.
The court will hear the case against the company next month.
note_fa: یعنی پرونده؛ هم در پلیس هم در دادگاه به‌کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: A mobile phone.
example_en: My cell is ringing, I need to answer it.
examples_extra: He called her on his cell phone.
Cell phones are not allowed in the exam room.

meaning_en: A document listing your education and work experience.
example_en: I sent my CV to the company.
examples_extra: She sent her CV to ten different companies.
Keep your CV short, no more than two pages.
note_fa: مخفف curriculum vitae؛ در آمریکا résumé می‌گویند.

meaning_en: Genetic information in cells, unique to each person.
example_en: Scientists study DNA to understand genetics.
examples_extra: DNA carries the genetic information of every living thing.
Scientists studied the DNA of the ancient bones.

meaning_en: Short for Doctor, a title for a medical professional.
example_en: Dr. Smith is my family doctor.
examples_extra: Dr Brown will see you at three o'clock.
Please call Dr Smith if the fever continues.
note_fa: مخفف Doctor؛ قبل از اسم پزشک یا دکترای دانشگاهی می‌آید.

meaning_en: For example.
example_en: Bring some fruit, e.g., apples or bananas.
examples_extra: Many fruits are rich in vitamin C, e.g. oranges and kiwis.
Bring warm clothes, e.g. a jacket and gloves.
note_fa: یعنی «مثلاً»؛ در متن رسمی به جای for example به کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: And other similar things; and so on.
example_en: I like apples, bananas, etc.
examples_extra: Bring pens, notebooks, etc. to the first class.
She enjoys hiking, swimming, cycling, etc. at weekends.
note_fa: همان etc با نقطه؛ هر دو درست‌اند.

meaning_en: European Union, a group of European countries.
example_en: The EU has many member states.
examples_extra: The EU introduced new rules on food labelling.
Several countries joined the EU in two thousand four.

meaning_en: A test of your knowledge or ability.
example_en: I have an English exam tomorrow.
examples_extra: She has a maths exam on Friday morning.
He passed his driving exam on the second try.

meaning_en: Frequently Asked Questions; a list of common questions.
example_en: Check the FAQ section for answers.
examples_extra: Check the FAQ page before asking.
The website's FAQ answered my question.

meaning_en: A common illness like a bad cold.
example_en: I have the flu and feel very tired.
examples_extra: He stayed in bed for a week with the flu.
Many people catch the flu in the cold winter months.
note_fa: آنفلوآنزا؛ همیشه با the می‌آید: the flu.

meaning_en: Used to give an instance of something.
example_en: Many fruits are healthy, for example, apples.
examples_extra: Many fruits are rich in vitamin C, for example, oranges.
For example, you could take the bus instead.

meaning_en: a machine that keeps food cold.
example_en: Put the milk in the fridge.
examples_extra: The milk is in the fridge.
Our fridge broke down yesterday.

meaning_en: A live performance by a musician or band.
example_en: The band is playing a gig tonight.
examples_extra: The band played a great gig last night.
We're going to a gig on Saturday.
note_fa: غیررسمی: یعنی کنسرت؛ کوتاه‌شدهٔ gigabyte هم هست.

meaning_en: General Manager, a high-level boss in a company.
example_en: The GM announced new company policies today.
examples_extra: The GM approved the new project.
She became the GM of the company last year.
note_fa: مخفف General Manager؛ یعنی مدیر ارشد.

meaning_en: A place for exercise and sports.
example_en: I go to the gym every morning.
examples_extra: I go to the gym three times a week after work.
The school gym is used for basketball and volleyball.
note_fa: باشگاه ورزشی؛ go to the gym یعنی «باشگاه رفتن».

meaning_en: Using the newest and most advanced technology.
example_en: This new phone is very high-tech.
examples_extra: They work in a high-tech industry.
The hospital has high-tech equipment.

meaning_en: That is; in other words.
example_en: The price includes tax, i.e., it's the final cost.
examples_extra: He likes winter sports, i.e. skiing and skating.
Bring warm clothes, i.e. a coat and gloves.
note_fa: یعنی «به عبارت دیگر»؛ با e.g. فرق دارد.

meaning_en: A document proving who you are.
example_en: Please show your ID to enter the building.
examples_extra: Do you have an ID card?
Show your ID at the door.
note_fa: مخفف identification؛ با حروف خوانده می‌شود.

meaning_en: To explain something more simply.
example_en: He is very busy; in other words, he has no free time.
examples_extra: He's too tired to work; in other words, he needs rest.
The plan failed. In other words, we must start again.

meaning_en: A written note saying you owe money.
example_en: He gave me an IOU for the ten dollars.
examples_extra: He gave me an IOU for fifty dollars.
I wrote her an IOU and paid later.

meaning_en: Internet Service Provider; a company that gives internet access.
example_en: My ISP provides fast internet for my home.
examples_extra: Our ISP offers fast broadband.
She changed her ISP last month.

meaning_en: A unit of weight, one thousand grams.
example_en: I bought a kilo of apples.
examples_extra: I bought two kilos of apples.
A kilo of rice costs two pounds.
note_fa: مخفف kilogram؛ با of: a kilo of برنج.

meaning_en: A room for scientific experiments (short for laboratory).
example_en: We do science experiments in the school lab.
examples_extra: The scientists work in the lab.
Our school has a new computer lab.

meaning_en: A strong, narrow beam of light.
example_en: Doctors use lasers in some operations.
examples_extra: The laser pointed at the screen.
Doctors use lasers in surgery.
note_fa: پرتو لیزر؛ laser printer چاپگر لیزری.

meaning_en: The study of numbers and shapes.
example_en: I like maths at school.
examples_extra: Maths is my favourite subject.
She is good at maths.

meaning_en: British foreign intelligence service.
example_en: MI6 gathers intelligence from other countries.
examples_extra: He works for MI6 in London.
MI6 is Britain’s foreign intelligence service.
note_fa: یعنی سازمان اطلاعات خارجی بریتانیا؛ معادل CIA آمریکا.

meaning_en: able to move or be moved easily
example_en: My phone is mobile, I can take it anywhere.
examples_extra: She bought a new mobile phone.
My mobile is out of battery.
note_fa: بریتانیایی: mobile phone؛ آمریکایی: cell phone.

meaning_en: Member of Parliament; a person elected to parliament
example_en: Our local MP visited the school.
examples_extra: She was elected MP for Leeds North last year.
The young MP spoke in Parliament yesterday.
note_fa: نماینده مجلس بریتانیا؛ Member of Parliament.

meaning_en: title for a man, married or unmarried
example_en: Mr. Smith is my teacher.
examples_extra: Mr Smith is our kind new English teacher.
Good morning, Mr Brown, how are you today?
note_fa: آقای؛ قبل از نام خانوادگی مردان.

meaning_en: title for a married woman
example_en: Mrs. Jones lives next door.
examples_extra: Kind Mrs Jones lives right next door to us.
Thank you very much indeed, dear Mrs White.

meaning_en: North Atlantic Treaty Organization, a military alliance.
example_en: NATO is an important international organization.
examples_extra: The NATO alliance was originally founded in 1949.
Several European countries joined NATO in recent decades.

meaning_en: A personal computer.
example_en: I use my PC for work and games.
examples_extra: I bought a new PC last week.
Do you have a PC or a laptop?

meaning_en: A device for talking to people.
example_en: My phone is ringing.
examples_extra: My phone ran out of battery.
She answered the phone quickly.
note_fa: answer the phone یعنی جواب دادن؛ on the phone یعنی در حال مکالمه.

meaning_en: A picture taken with a camera.
example_en: I took a nice photo of the sunset.
examples_extra: She took a photo of the sunset.
Can you send me that photo?
note_fa: کتاب: take a photo؛ take a photo of somebody.

meaning_en: a secret number for your bank card.
example_en: Don't tell anyone your PIN.
examples_extra: Enter your PIN at the cashpoint.
Do not share your PIN with anyone.
note_fa: مخفف Personal Identification Number؛ رمز کارت بانکی.

meaning_en: an aircraft that flies in the sky.
example_en: We traveled by plane to London.
examples_extra: The plane landed on time.
We travelled by plane last summer.
note_fa: هواپیما؛ by plane یعنی با هواپیما.

meaning_en: Prime Minister, the leader of a government.
example_en: The PM gave a speech today.
examples_extra: The PM spoke to the nation.
She met the PM yesterday.
note_fa: در کتاب نیست؛ مخفف Prime Minister (نخست‌وزیر).

meaning_en: Postscript; extra message at the end of a letter.
example_en: I forgot to mention it, PS, call me later.
examples_extra: He added a PS at the end.
PS: don't forget the keys.

meaning_en: Please turn over; used to tell you to look on the next page.
example_en: The exam paper said "PTO" at the bottom.
examples_extra: The note said PTO at the bottom.
PTO means please turn over.

meaning_en: a system using radio waves to find objects
example_en: Air traffic control uses radar to track planes.
examples_extra: The plane appeared on the radar.
Bats use a kind of radar.

meaning_en: Rest in Peace; used for someone who has died.
example_en: The gravestone had 'RIP John Smith' written on it.
examples_extra: The headstone read RIP at the bottom.
RIP is often carved on old gravestones.
note_fa: مخفف Rest in peace: روحش شاد.

meaning_en: Please reply to an invitation.
example_en: Please RSVP by Friday if you can come.
examples_extra: The invitation asked guests to RSVP by Friday.
Please RSVP so we know how many seats to book.

meaning_en: Not happy; feeling unhappy.
example_en: She felt sad when her pet died.
examples_extra: She felt sad after the film.
It is sad that he left.

meaning_en: A person who sells products for a company.
example_en: My brother works as a sales rep.
examples_extra: The sales rep visited our office.
She works as a sales rep.

meaning_en: A device that shows you how to get somewhere.
example_en: My satnav helped me find the hotel.
examples_extra: The satnav showed the fastest route.
We followed the satnav to the hotel.
note_fa: کتاب: satnav = satellite navigation؛ مسیریاب ماهواره‌ای.

meaning_en: Short for science fiction.
example_en: I love watching sci-fi movies.
examples_extra: He loves sci-fi films a lot.
Sci-fi books imagine the future vividly.

meaning_en: Equipment for breathing underwater (Self-Contained Underwater Breathing Apparatus).
example_en: He learned how to use scuba gear.
examples_extra: They went scuba diving in Egypt.
Good scuba gear is expensive.
note_fa: مخفف Self-Contained Underwater Breathing Apparatus؛ غواصی.

meaning_en: A system using sound waves to find objects underwater.
example_en: Submarines use sonar to navigate.
examples_extra: Submarines use sonar to find objects underwater.
The ship's sonar detected a large object nearby.

meaning_en: Short for "Saint" or "Street".
example_en: My address is 10 St. Paul's Road.
examples_extra: They live at 12 St John Street.
The town of St Andrews is famous for golf.

meaning_en: Informal word for television.
example_en: Let's watch some telly tonight.
examples_extra: Please turn on the telly.
We watched telly last night.

meaning_en: To explain something more clearly.
example_en: He's a vegetarian, that's to say, he doesn't eat meat.
examples_extra: He’s ill, that’s to say he has flu.
It’s cheap, that’s to say it’s free.

meaning_en: British Broadcasting Corporation, a UK media company.
example_en: I watch the news on the BBC.
examples_extra: The BBC is funded by a licence fee paid by viewers.
She works as a reporter for the BBC World Service.

meaning_en: Central Intelligence Agency, a US spy agency.
example_en: The CIA gathers information for the US government.
examples_extra: The CIA is the foreign intelligence agency of the United States.
He claimed to be working undercover for the CIA.

meaning_en: The European Union, a group of European countries.
example_en: The EU has many member states.
examples_extra: The EU sets common rules for trade among its members.
Croatia joined the EU in the year two thousand thirteen.

meaning_en: Federal Bureau of Investigation, a US police agency.
example_en: The FBI investigates serious crimes in the US.
examples_extra: The FBI investigates serious federal crimes in America.
Agents from the FBI arrested the suspect early this morning.

meaning_en: Abbreviation for the United Nations.
example_en: The UN works for world peace.
examples_extra: The UN sent emergency aid.
She works for the UN in Geneva.
note_fa: در کتاب نیست؛ مخفف United Nations؛ با the.

meaning_en: Short for university.
example_en: I'm going to uni next year.
examples_extra: She is starting uni in September.
My brother goes to uni in Leeds.
note_fa: غیررسمی و کوتاه‌شده‌ی university؛ بیشتر بریتانیایی.

meaning_en: an animal doctor
example_en: We took our dog to the vet.
examples_extra: We took our sick dog to the vet.
The kind vet gave the sick cat medicine.

meaning_en: asking what an abbreviation represents
example_en: What does "NASA" stand for?
examples_extra: What does BBC stand for?
What does this symbol stand for?

meaning_en: World Health Organization
example_en: The WHO works to improve global health.
examples_extra: The WHO sent aid to the region.
New WHO guidelines recommend vaccination.

meaning_en: An abbreviation formed from initial letters, pronounced as a word.
example_en: NASA is an acronym for National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
examples_extra: NATO is a well-known acronym.
The report was full of acronyms.

meaning_en: Before Christ; used for dates before year 1.

examples_extra: Rome was founded in 753 BC.
The temple dates from 500 BC.
note_fa: یعنی «قبل از میلاد»؛ BCE هم همین معنی است.

meaning_en: Before the Common Era; same as BC.
example_en: Many ancient civilizations flourished thousands of years BCE.
examples_extra: The site dates from 2000 BCE.
BCE means before the Common Era.
note_fa: یعنی «قبل از دوران مشترک»؛ معادل BC.

meaning_en: A single room used for sleeping, living, and cooking.
example_en: Many students live in small bedsits in the city.
examples_extra: He rents a tiny bedsit near the station.
A bedsit was all she could afford in London.

meaning_en: Biographical data; information about a person's life.
example_en: Please submit your biodata along with your application.
examples_extra: Please send your biodata with the application.
Her biodata lists twenty years of experience.

meaning_en: A biographical movie about a real person's life.
example_en: The new biopic about the singer was critically acclaimed.
examples_extra: The biopic about the singer won awards.
They are filming a biopic of the famous painter.

meaning_en: Common Era, used after a date, same as AD.
example_en: The Roman Empire fell in 476 CE.
examples_extra: The temple dates from 200 CE.
She was born in 1990 CE.
note_fa: در کتاب نیست؛ مخفف Common Era؛ معادل AD.

meaning_en: Compare (used in academic texts).
example_en: For more details, cf. Chapter 3.
examples_extra: See chapter five, cf. page twenty.
The results differ, cf. earlier studies.
note_fa: در کتاب نیست؛ مخفف confer؛ «مقایسه کن» (متون دانشگاهی).

meaning_en: Abbreviation for "editor" or "edition."
example_en: The book's second ed. includes new chapters.
examples_extra: Please see the 3rd ed. of the book.
He is the current ed. of the journal.

meaning_en: And others (used in academic citations).
example_en: The research by Smith et al. was groundbreaking.
examples_extra: The study by Carter et al. changed the field.
Smith et al. published their findings in 2019.

meaning_en: Abbreviation for "figure," referring to an illustration or diagram.
example_en: Please refer to Fig. 3 for a detailed diagram.
examples_extra: See fig. 3 for details.
The diagram is labelled fig. 2.

meaning_en: Short for information.
example_en: Can you give me some info about the event?
examples_extra: Click here for more info.
She gave me all the info.

meaning_en: Intelligence Quotient; a measure of a person's intelligence.
example_en: Her high IQ helped her excel in complex problem-solving.
examples_extra: He has an IQ of 140.
She took an IQ test.
note_fa: مخفف intelligence quotient؛ یعنی بهره‌ی هوشی.

meaning_en: Nota Bene; used to draw attention to something important.
example_en: NB: Please submit your assignments by Friday.
examples_extra: NB: tomorrow's exam starts very early indeed.
Please read the NB at the bottom carefully.

meaning_en: Abbreviation for "page" or "pages".
example_en: Please refer to p. 25 for more details.
examples_extra: See p. 42 for details.
You'll find it on p. 10.

meaning_en: Unidentified Flying Object; an object seen in the sky.
example_en: Many people claim to have seen a UFO in the night sky.
examples_extra: He claims he saw a UFO.
UFOs are often reported at night.

meaning_en: Universal Serial Bus; a standard for connecting devices.
example_en: I need a USB cable to charge my phone.
examples_extra: Save the files on a USB.
She bought a new USB drive.

meaning_en: Very Important Person; someone treated specially.
example_en: Only VIPs were allowed access to the backstage area.
examples_extra: They treated us like VIPs.
The VIPs arrived by helicopter.
